new_repository_result: The JANUS route now has a complete proof-carrying extractor for all pairwise Horn equality consequences, a linear-size emitted equality basis, and a proof that satisfiable Horn disequalities collapse to unary facts.
claim_boundary: The sources and C037.1 establish a restricted pairwise consequence bridge only; unrestricted Horn-affine satisfiability and P versus NP remain open.
